title: Rock Paper Scissors: simultaneous moves
description: Two players simultaneously choose rock, paper, or scissors. Rock beats scissors, scissors beats paper, paper beats rock. Best of N rounds. Validates: simultaneous phase support (simultaneous:true in phase definition — declared in schema but never tested), server submission gate (collect both moves before revealing), hidden per-round choices, simple win/draw/loss resolution. Trivial game but the only way to validate the simultaneous move architecture.
